n1.speaker: callum
n1.text: Have you heard? Apparently your office is merging with the Leeds branch. Everyone's been talking about it in here all week.

translations.fa: شنیدی؟ ظاهراً دفترتون داره با شعبهٔ لیدز ادغام میشه. کل هفته همه اینجا دربارهٔ اون حرف می‌زنن.

branches.suggestion: I've heard rumours, but nobody has confirmed anything.
branches.suggestionFa: شایعه شنیدم، ولی کسی چیزی را تأیید نکرده.

n2.speaker: callum
n2.text: One of your lot came in yesterday. He claimed the announcement was coming on Monday, but then he admitted he'd only overheard it.

translations.fa: یکی از شماها دیروز اومد. ادعا کرد اعلامیه دوشنبه میاد، ولی بعد اعتراف کرد فقط به‌طور اتفاقی شنیده.

branches.suggestion: So it might not be true at all.
Did anyone from management say anything?

n3.speaker: callum
n3.text: Your manager was in this morning. Someone asked her straight out, and she denied there were any plans to close the office.

translations.fa: مدیرتون امروز صبح اینجا بود. یکی رک ازش پرسید، و انکار کرد که برنامه‌ای برای بستن دفتر باشه.

branches.suggestion: That's a relief. But "merging" and "closing" aren't the same thing.
branches.suggestionFa: خیالم راحت شد. ولی «ادغام» و «بستن» یکی نیستن.

branches.suggestion: Denying it doesn't mean it's not happening, though.
branches.suggestionFa: انکار کردن به این معنی نیست که اتفاق نمی‌افته.

n4.speaker: callum
n4.text: Good point. Then she suggested everyone wait for the official email instead of listening to gossip. Which is exactly what I'm doing now. Oops.

translations.fa: نکتهٔ خوبیه. بعد پیشنهاد کرد همه به جای گوش دادن به شایعه منتظر ایمیل رسمی باشن. که دقیقاً همون کاریه که الان دارم می‌کنم. اوه.

branches.suggestion: Ha! You're the office's unofficial newsroom.
branches.suggestionFa: ها! تو اتاق خبر غیررسمی دفتری.

branches.suggestion: She's right. I'll wait and see.
branches.suggestionFa: حق با اونه. صبر می‌کنم ببینم.

cultureNote.en: "Your lot" is informal British for "your group of people". It can sound friendly or slightly cheeky depending on tone.

n5.speaker: callum
n5.text: Guilty! Right — flat white, extra hot. And if you hear anything juicy, you know where I am.

translations.fa: گناهکارم! خب — فلت وایت، خیلی داغ. و اگه چیز جالبی شنیدی، می‌دونی من کجام.
